## Functions

### `from_env`

```badger
fn from_env<T>(prefix: String) -> Result<T, Error> !{Io} where T: Codec
```

Decode required record fields from prefixed environment variables
(`PREFIX` + upper-cased field name). Missing variables and failed
conversions are structured errors.

### `load`

```badger
fn load<T>(prefix: String) -> Result<T, Error> !{Io} where T: Codec
```

Decode the effective configuration: the project's `[config]` table merged
with the selected `[profile.NAME]` (`badger run --profile NAME`), overlaid
by prefixed environment variables (`PREFIX` + upper-cased field name).
A configured value may read the environment: `"${NAME}"` (which must be
set) or `"${NAME:-default}"`; `$${` is a literal `${`. The project's
`[env] dotenv` files are loaded before the program starts.
